    jvm

    AInternalFluidTagsProvider¶

    class AInternalFluidTagsProvider(output: PackOutput, registriesFuture: CompletableFuture<HolderLookup.Provider>) : ATagsProvider.FluidTagsProvider

    Populates Archie's vanilla-derived common ("c") fluid tags (see ACommonTags.Fluids) with their vanilla fluid members, so downstream mods can depend on the c tag convention without every mod having to redeclare it.

    Constructors¶
